decisions.reason: As a recently launched extension of the firm’s established laser-marking range with several models, it fits the company’s core portfolio and should benefit from its service, integration and customization strengths.

This thermal inkjet printer is close to the firm’s existing offer and supports its strategy of application-specific coding solutions, so a growing and investing large manufacturer would likely continue backing it.

Although somewhat more specialized and potentially overlapping with other printing technologies, the piezo inkjet printer still aligns well with the firm’s Industry 4.0 traceability direction and broad coding portfolio, making withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.
